title: Resolvent algebras and limit states of interacting canonical ensembles
summary: The limit states of canonical ensembles of a large number of interacting bosons at a given temperature, which are confined by harmonic forces, are studied in the framework of the resolvent algebra. It is shown that the limits satisfy the KMS condition or are ground states, regardless of the type of interaction. In case of attractive forces, where the ensembles collapse, observables that become meaningless in the limit disappear from the limit representations.
